correctness.rationale: Exact 10-state rational polynomial certificate and uniqueness of finite-chain absorption solve the full r>0 problem. Three polynomial differences verified identically; positive coefficients eliminate the third seed type and Descartes rule proves unique positive crossover. Independent 30-state exact-rational linear systems at eight fitness values reproduce all 240 transient probabilities.

value.rationale: The natural smallest unequal complete bipartite population with both parts nontrivial exhibits a sharp transition from concentrating seeds at highest-degree individuals to distributing seeds across degree classes. The exact optimal placement and fitness threshold quantify a real intervention tradeoff not determined by neutral rankings or general approximation guarantees; no claim for larger classes or new generic rank-reversal is made.
